About ADA compliance: Under ADA Title II, state and local government entities, including public museums and galleries, must ensure digital content is accessible. Private galleries open to the public may also face requirements under Title III. Several states have enacted additional accessibility mandates with specific deadlines. This scorecard provides general guidance and is not legal advice.
